ar.title: سورة نوح مكتوبة بخط كبير: 28 آية مع الترجمة الإنجليزية
ar.html:
نقدم سورة نوح مكتوبة بخط كبير، وعدد آياتها 28، مع تلاوة صوتية آية بآية.

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

سورة نوح

إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ نوح [1]
قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ نوح [2]
أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ نوح [3]
يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ اللَّهِ إِذَا جَاءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ نوح [4]
قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِي لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا نوح [5]
فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَائِي إِلَّا فِرَارًا نوح [6]
وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوا أَصَابِعَهُمْ فِي آذَانِهِمْ وَاسْتَغْشَوْا ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا اسْتِكْبَارًا نوح [7]
ثُمَّ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا نوح [8]
ثُمَّ إِنِّي أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا نوح [9]
فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفَّارًا نوح [10]
يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا نوح [11]
وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَالٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَارًا نوح [12]
مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا نوح [13]
وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا نوح [14]
أَلَمْ تَرَوْا كَيْفَ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا نوح [15]
وَجَعَلَ الْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا نوح [16]
وَاللَّهُ أَنبَتَكُم مِّنَ الْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا نوح [17]
ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا نوح [18]
وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا نوح [19]
لِّتَسْلُكُوا مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا نوح [20]
قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِي وَاتَّبَعُوا مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُ وَوَلَدُهُ إِلَّا خَسَارًا نوح [21]
وَمَكَرُوا مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا نوح [22]
وَقَالُوا لَا تَذَرُنَّ آلِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا نوح [23]
وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَالًا نوح [24]
مِّمَّا خَطِيئَاتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا فَأُدْخِلُوا نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا لَهُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ أَنصَارًا نوح [25]
وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ دَيَّارًا نوح [26]
إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوا إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا نوح [27]
رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًا نوح [28]

en.title: Surah Nooh written in large font: 28 verses with English translation
en.html:
Surah Nooh written in large font. It has 28 verses, with audio recitation for each verse.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah Nooh

Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment." Nooh [1]
He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner, Nooh [2]
[Saying], 'Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me. Nooh [3]
Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew.' " Nooh [4]
He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day. Nooh [5]
But my invitation increased them not except in flight. Nooh [6]
And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance. Nooh [7]
Then I invited them publicly. Nooh [8]
Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly Nooh [9]
And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver. Nooh [10]
He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers Nooh [11]
And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers. Nooh [12]
What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur Nooh [13]
While He has created you in stages? Nooh [14]
Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers Nooh [15]
And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp? Nooh [16]
And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth. Nooh [17]
Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction. Nooh [18]
And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse Nooh [19]
That you may follow therein roads of passage.' " Nooh [20]
Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss. Nooh [21]
And they conspired an immense conspiracy. Nooh [22]
And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr. Nooh [23]
And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error." Nooh [24]
Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers. Nooh [25]
And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant. Nooh [26]
Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever. Nooh [27]
My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction." Nooh [28]

ar.title: سورة الجن مكتوبة بخط كبير: 28 آية مع الترجمة الإنجليزية
ar.html:
نقدم سورة الجن مكتوبة بخط كبير، وعدد آياتها 28، مع تلاوة صوتية آية بآية.

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

سورة الجن

قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَقَالُوا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآنًا عَجَبًا الجن [1]
يَهْدِي إِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَآمَنَّا بِهِ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا أَحَدًا الجن [2]
وَأَنَّهُ تَعَالَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا الجن [3]
وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ شَطَطًا الجن [4]
وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَن لَّن تَقُولَ الْإِنسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا الجن [5]
وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ الْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا الجن [6]
وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ اللَّهُ أَحَدًا الجن [7]
وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا السَّمَاءَ فَوَجَدْنَاهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا الجن [8]
وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ الْآنَ يَجِدْ لَهُ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا الجن [9]
وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِي أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا الجن [10]
وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الصَّالِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَائِقَ قِدَدًا الجن [11]
وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ اللَّهَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُ هَرَبًا الجن [12]
وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا الْهُدَىٰ آمَنَّا بِهِ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِن بِرَبِّهِ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا الجن [13]
وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُولَٰئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا رَشَدًا الجن [14]
وَأَمَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا الجن [15]
وَأَن لَّوِ اسْتَقَامُوا عَلَى الطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَاهُم مَّاءً غَدَقًا الجن [16]
لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا الجن [17]
وَأَنَّ الْمَسَاجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا مَعَ اللَّهِ أَحَدًا الجن [18]
وَأَنَّهُ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا الجن [19]
قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَدْعُو رَبِّي وَلَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ أَحَدًا الجن [20]
قُلْ إِنِّي لَا أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا الجن [21]
قُلْ إِنِّي لَن يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ اللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِ مُلْتَحَدًا الجن [22]
إِلَّا بَلَاغًا مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَرِسَالَاتِهِ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ لَهُ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا الجن [23]
حَتَّىٰ إِذَا رَأَوْا مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا الجن [24]
قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِي أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُ رَبِّي أَمَدًا الجن [25]
عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِ أَحَدًا الجن [26]
إِلَّا مَنِ ارْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُ يَسْلُكُ مِن بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ رَصَدًا الجن [27]
لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَدَدًا الجن [28]

en.title: Surah Al-Jinn written in large font: 28 verses with English translation
en.html:
Surah Al-Jinn written in large font. It has 28 verses, with audio recitation for each verse.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah Al-Jinn

Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an. Al-Jinn [1]
It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone. Al-Jinn [2]
And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son Al-Jinn [3]
And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression. Al-Jinn [4]
And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie. Al-Jinn [5]
And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden. Al-Jinn [6]
And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger]. Al-Jinn [7]
And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames. Al-Jinn [8]
And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him. Al-Jinn [9]
And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course. Al-Jinn [10]
And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways. Al-Jinn [11]
And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight. Al-Jinn [12]
And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden. Al-Jinn [13]
And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course. Al-Jinn [14]
But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.' Al-Jinn [15]
And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision Al-Jinn [16]
So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment. Al-Jinn [17]
And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah, so do not invoke with Allah anyone. Al-Jinn [18]
And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass." Al-Jinn [19]
Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone." Al-Jinn [20]
Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction." Al-Jinn [21]
Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge. Al-Jinn [22]
But [I have for you] only notification from Allah, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever. Al-Jinn [23]
[The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number. Al-Jinn [24]
Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period." Al-Jinn [25]
[He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone Al-Jinn [26]
Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers Al-Jinn [27]
That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number. Al-Jinn [28]

ar.title: سورة المزمل مكتوبة بخط كبير: 20 آية مع الترجمة الإنجليزية
ar.html:
نقدم سورة المزمل مكتوبة بخط كبير، وعدد آياتها 20، مع تلاوة صوتية آية بآية.

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

سورة المزمل

يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُزَّمِّلُ المزمل [1]
قُمِ اللَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا المزمل [2]
نِّصْفَهُ أَوِ انقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا المزمل [3]
أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ الْقُرْآنَ تَرْتِيلًا المزمل [4]
إِنَّا سَنُلْقِي عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا المزمل [5]
إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ اللَّيْلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطْئًا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا المزمل [6]
إِنَّ لَكَ فِي النَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا المزمل [7]
وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا المزمل [8]
رَّبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَاتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا المزمل [9]
وَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَاهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا المزمل [10]
وَذَرْنِي وَالْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُولِي النَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا المزمل [11]
إِنَّ لَدَيْنَا أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا المزمل [12]
وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا المزمل [13]
يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ الْأَرْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ الْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا المزمل [14]
إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَاهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا المزمل [15]
فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ الرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَاهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا المزمل [16]
فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ الْوِلْدَانَ شِيبًا المزمل [17]
السَّمَاءُ مُنفَطِرٌ بِهِ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُ مَفْعُولًا المزمل [18]
إِنَّ هَٰذِهِ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا المزمل [19]
إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَيِ اللَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُ وَثُلُثَهُ وَطَائِفَةٌ مِّنَ الَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَاللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَآخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ اللَّهِ ۙ وَآخَرُونَ يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۖ فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ اللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا ۚ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا اللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ المزمل [20]

en.title: Surah Al-Muzzammil written in large font: 20 verses with English translation
en.html:
Surah Al-Muzzammil written in large font. It has 20 verses, with audio recitation for each verse.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah Al-Muzzammil

O you who wraps himself [in clothing], Al-Muzzammil [1]
Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little - Al-Muzzammil [2]
Half of it - or subtract from it a little Al-Muzzammil [3]
Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation. Al-Muzzammil [4]
Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word. Al-Muzzammil [5]
Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words. Al-Muzzammil [6]
Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation. Al-Muzzammil [7]
And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion. Al-Muzzammil [8]
[He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs. Al-Muzzammil [9]
And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance. Al-Muzzammil [10]
And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little. Al-Muzzammil [11]
Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire Al-Muzzammil [12]
And food that chokes and a painful punishment - Al-Muzzammil [13]
On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down. Al-Muzzammil [14]
Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger. Al-Muzzammil [15]
But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure. Al-Muzzammil [16]
Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired? Al-Muzzammil [17]
The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled. Al-Muzzammil [18]
Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way. Al-Muzzammil [19]
Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. Al-Muzzammil [20]

ar.title: سورة المدثر مكتوبة بخط كبير: 56 آية مع الترجمة الإنجليزية
ar.html:
نقدم سورة المدثر مكتوبة بخط كبير، وعدد آياتها 56، مع تلاوة صوتية آية بآية.

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

سورة المدثر

يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ المدثر [1]
قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ المدثر [2]
وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ المدثر [3]
وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ المدثر [4]
وَالرُّجْزَ فَاهْجُرْ المدثر [5]
وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ المدثر [6]
وَلِرَبِّكَ فَاصْبِرْ المدثر [7]
فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِي النَّاقُورِ المدثر [8]
فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ المدثر [9]
عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍ المدثر [10]
ذَرْنِي وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا المدثر [11]
وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُ مَالًا مَّمْدُودًا المدثر [12]
وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا المدثر [13]
وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُ تَمْهِيدًا المدثر [14]
ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ المدثر [15]
كَلَّا ۖ إِنَّهُ كَانَ لِآيَاتِنَا عَنِيدًا المدثر [16]
سَأُرْهِقُهُ صَعُودًا المدثر [17]
إِنَّهُ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ المدثر [18]
فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ المدثر [19]
ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ المدثر [20]
ثُمَّ نَظَرَ المدثر [21]
ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ المدثر [22]
ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَاسْتَكْبَرَ المدثر [23]
فَقَالَ إِنْ هَٰذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ المدثر [24]
إِنْ هَٰذَا إِلَّا قَوْلُ الْبَشَرِ المدثر [25]
سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ المدثر [26]
وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا سَقَرُ المدثر [27]
لَا تُبْقِي وَلَا تَذَرُ المدثر [28]
لَوَّاحَةٌ لِّلْبَشَرِ المدثر [29]
عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ المدثر [30]
وَمَا جَعَلْنَا أَصْحَابَ النَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَائِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ وَيَزْدَادَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِيمَانًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَالْكَافِرُونَ مَاذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِيَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ المدثر [31]
كَلَّا وَالْقَمَرِ المدثر [32]
وَاللَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ المدثر [33]
وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا أَسْفَرَ المدثر [34]
إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى الْكُبَرِ المدثر [35]
نَذِيرًا لِّلْبَشَرِ المدثر [36]
لِمَن شَاءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ المدثر [37]
كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ المدثر [38]
إِلَّا أَصْحَابَ الْيَمِينِ المدثر [39]
فِي جَنَّاتٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ المدثر [40]
عَنِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ المدثر [41]
مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِي سَقَرَ المدثر [42]
قَالُوا لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ الْمُصَلِّينَ المدثر [43]
وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ الْمِسْكِينَ المدثر [44]
وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ الْخَائِضِينَ المدثر [45]
وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ المدثر [46]
حَتَّىٰ أَتَانَا الْيَقِينُ المدثر [47]
فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَاعَةُ الشَّافِعِينَ المدثر [48]
فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ التَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ المدثر [49]
كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ المدثر [50]
فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍ المدثر [51]
بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً المدثر [52]
كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ الْآخِرَةَ المدثر [53]
كَلَّا إِنَّهُ تَذْكِرَةٌ المدثر [54]
فَمَن شَاءَ ذَكَرَهُ المدثر [55]
وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّا أَن يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ التَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ المدثر [56]

en.title: Surah Al-Muddaththir written in large font: 56 verses with English translation
en.html:
Surah Al-Muddaththir written in large font. It has 56 verses, with audio recitation for each verse.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah Al-Muddaththir

O you who covers himself [with a garment], Al-Muddaththir [1]
Arise and warn Al-Muddaththir [2]
And your Lord glorify Al-Muddaththir [3]
And your clothing purify Al-Muddaththir [4]
And uncleanliness avoid Al-Muddaththir [5]
And do not confer favor to acquire more Al-Muddaththir [6]
But for your Lord be patient. Al-Muddaththir [7]
And when the trumpet is blown, Al-Muddaththir [8]
That Day will be a difficult day Al-Muddaththir [9]
For the disbelievers - not easy. Al-Muddaththir [10]
Leave Me with the one I created alone Al-Muddaththir [11]
And to whom I granted extensive wealth Al-Muddaththir [12]
And children present [with him] Al-Muddaththir [13]
And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life]. Al-Muddaththir [14]
Then he desires that I should add more. Al-Muddaththir [15]
No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate. Al-Muddaththir [16]
I will cover him with arduous torment. Al-Muddaththir [17]
Indeed, he thought and deliberated. Al-Muddaththir [18]
So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated. Al-Muddaththir [19]
Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated. Al-Muddaththir [20]
Then he considered [again]; Al-Muddaththir [21]
Then he frowned and scowled; Al-Muddaththir [22]
Then he turned back and was arrogant Al-Muddaththir [23]
And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others]. Al-Muddaththir [24]
This is not but the word of a human being." Al-Muddaththir [25]
I will drive him into Saqar. Al-Muddaththir [26]
And what can make you know what is Saqar? Al-Muddaththir [27]
It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned], Al-Muddaththir [28]
Blackening the skins. Al-Muddaththir [29]
Over it are nineteen [angels]. Al-Muddaththir [30]
And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is hypocrisy and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allah intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allah leave astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And mention of the Fire is not but a reminder to humanity. Al-Muddaththir [31]
No! By the moon Al-Muddaththir [32]
And [by] the night when it departs Al-Muddaththir [33]
And [by] the morning when it brightens, Al-Muddaththir [34]
Indeed, the Fire is of the greatest [afflictions] Al-Muddaththir [35]
As a warning to humanity - Al-Muddaththir [36]
To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind. Al-Muddaththir [37]
Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained Al-Muddaththir [38]
Except the companions of the right, Al-Muddaththir [39]
[Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other Al-Muddaththir [40]
About the criminals, Al-Muddaththir [41]
[And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?" Al-Muddaththir [42]
They will say, "We were not of those who prayed, Al-Muddaththir [43]
Nor did we used to feed the poor. Al-Muddaththir [44]
And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it], Al-Muddaththir [45]
And we used to deny the Day of Recompense Al-Muddaththir [46]
Until there came to us the certainty." Al-Muddaththir [47]
So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors. Al-Muddaththir [48]
Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away Al-Muddaththir [49]
As if they were alarmed donkeys Al-Muddaththir [50]
Fleeing from a lion? Al-Muddaththir [51]
Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about. Al-Muddaththir [52]
No! But they do not fear the Hereafter. Al-Muddaththir [53]
No! Indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder Al-Muddaththir [54]
Then whoever wills will remember it. Al-Muddaththir [55]
And they will not remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness. Al-Muddaththir [56]

ar.title: سورة القيامة مكتوبة بخط كبير: 40 آية مع الترجمة الإنجليزية
ar.html:
نقدم سورة القيامة مكتوبة بخط كبير، وعدد آياتها 40، مع تلاوة صوتية آية بآية.

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

سورة القيامة

لَا أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ القيامة [1]
وَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالنَّفْسِ اللَّوَّامَةِ القيامة [2]
أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنسَانُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُ القيامة [3]
بَلَىٰ قَادِرِينَ عَلَىٰ أَن نُّسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُ القيامة [4]
بَلْ يُرِيدُ الْإِنسَانُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُ القيامة [5]
يَسْأَلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ القيامة [6]
فَإِذَا بَرِقَ الْبَصَرُ القيامة [7]
وَخَسَفَ الْقَمَرُ القيامة [8]
وَجُمِعَ الشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ القيامة [9]
يَقُولُ الْإِنسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ الْمَفَرُّ القيامة [10]
كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ القيامة [11]
إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْمُسْتَقَرُّ القيامة [12]
يُنَبَّأُ الْإِنسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ القيامة [13]
بَلِ الْإِنسَانُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ بَصِيرَةٌ القيامة [14]
وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُ القيامة [15]
لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ القيامة [16]
إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُ وَقُرْآنَهُ القيامة [17]
فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَاهُ فَاتَّبِعْ قُرْآنَهُ القيامة [18]
ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُ القيامة [19]
كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ الْعَاجِلَةَ القيامة [20]
وَتَذَرُونَ الْآخِرَةَ القيامة [21]
وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ القيامة [22]
إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ القيامة [23]
وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَاسِرَةٌ القيامة [24]
تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ القيامة [25]
كَلَّا إِذَا بَلَغَتِ التَّرَاقِيَ القيامة [26]
وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍ القيامة [27]
وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ الْفِرَاقُ القيامة [28]
وَالْتَفَّتِ السَّاقُ بِالسَّاقِ القيامة [29]
إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْمَسَاقُ القيامة [30]
فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ القيامة [31]
وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ القيامة [32]
ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ يَتَمَطَّىٰ القيامة [33]
أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ القيامة [34]
ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ القيامة [35]
أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنسَانُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى القيامة [36]
أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِيٍّ يُمْنَىٰ القيامة [37]
ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ القيامة [38]
فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ الزَّوْجَيْنِ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنثَىٰ القيامة [39]
أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَىٰ أَن يُحْيِيَ الْمَوْتَىٰ القيامة [40]

en.title: Surah Al-Qiyamah written in large font: 40 verses with English translation
en.html:
Surah Al-Qiyamah written in large font. It has 40 verses, with audio recitation for each verse.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah Al-Qiyamah

I swear by the Day of Resurrection Al-Qiyamah [1]
And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection]. Al-Qiyamah [2]
Does man think that We will not assemble his bones? Al-Qiyamah [3]
Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips. Al-Qiyamah [4]
But man desires to continue in sin. Al-Qiyamah [5]
He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?" Al-Qiyamah [6]
So when vision is dazzled Al-Qiyamah [7]
And the moon darkens Al-Qiyamah [8]
And the sun and the moon are joined, Al-Qiyamah [9]
Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?" Al-Qiyamah [10]
No! There is no refuge. Al-Qiyamah [11]
To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence. Al-Qiyamah [12]
Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back. Al-Qiyamah [13]
Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness, Al-Qiyamah [14]
Even if he presents his excuses. Al-Qiyamah [15]
Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an. Al-Qiyamah [16]
Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation. Al-Qiyamah [17]
So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation. Al-Qiyamah [18]
Then upon Us is its clarification [to you]. Al-Qiyamah [19]
No! But you love the immediate Al-Qiyamah [20]
And leave the Hereafter. Al-Qiyamah [21]
[Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant, Al-Qiyamah [22]
Looking at their Lord. Al-Qiyamah [23]
And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted, Al-Qiyamah [24]
Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking. Al-Qiyamah [25]
No! When the soul has reached the collar bones Al-Qiyamah [26]
And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?" Al-Qiyamah [27]
And the dying one is certain that it is the [time of] separation Al-Qiyamah [28]
And the leg is wound about the leg, Al-Qiyamah [29]
To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession. Al-Qiyamah [30]
And the disbeliever had not believed, nor had he prayed. Al-Qiyamah [31]
But [instead], he denied and turned away. Al-Qiyamah [32]
And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride]. Al-Qiyamah [33]
Woe to you, and woe! Al-Qiyamah [34]
Then woe to you, and woe! Al-Qiyamah [35]
Does man think that he will be left neglected? Al-Qiyamah [36]
Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted? Al-Qiyamah [37]
Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allah] created [his form] and proportioned [him] Al-Qiyamah [38]
And made of him two mates, the male and the female. Al-Qiyamah [39]
Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead? Al-Qiyamah [40]

ar.title: سورة الإنسان مكتوبة بخط كبير: 31 آية مع الترجمة الإنجليزية
ar.html:
نقدم سورة الإنسان مكتوبة بخط كبير، وعدد آياتها 31، مع تلاوة صوتية آية بآية.

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

سورة الإنسان

هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى الْإِنسَانِ حِينٌ مِّنَ الدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْئًا مَّذْكُورًا الإنسان [1]
إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَاهُ سَمِيعًا بَصِيرًا الإنسان [2]
إِنَّا هَدَيْنَاهُ السَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا الإنسان [3]
إِنَّا أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَافِرِينَ سَلَاسِلَ وَأَغْلَالًا وَسَعِيرًا الإنسان [4]
إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا الإنسان [5]
عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ اللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا الإنسان [6]
يُوفُونَ بِالنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُ مُسْتَطِيرًا الإنسان [7]
وَيُطْعِمُونَ الطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا الإنسان [8]
إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَاءً وَلَا شُكُورًا الإنسان [9]
إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا الإنسان [10]
فَوَقَاهُمُ اللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّاهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا الإنسان [11]
وَجَزَاهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا الإنسان [12]
مُّتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا الإنسان [13]
وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَالُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا الإنسان [14]
وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِآنِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا الإنسان [15]
قَوَارِيرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا الإنسان [16]
وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا الإنسان [17]
عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا الإنسان [18]
وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا الإنسان [19]
وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا الإنسان [20]
عَالِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوا أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا الإنسان [21]
إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَاءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا الإنسان [22]
إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْآنَ تَنزِيلًا الإنسان [23]
فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ آثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا الإنسان [24]
وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا الإنسان [25]
وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَاسْجُدْ لَهُ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا الإنسان [26]
إِنَّ هَٰؤُلَاءِ يُحِبُّونَ الْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَاءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا الإنسان [27]
نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَاهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَا أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَا أَمْثَالَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا الإنسان [28]
إِنَّ هَٰذِهِ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا الإنسان [29]
وَمَا تَشَاءُونَ إِلَّا أَن يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا الإنسان [30]
يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَاءُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ وَالظَّالِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا الإنسان [31]

en.title: Surah Al-Insan written in large font: 31 verses with English translation
en.html:
Surah Al-Insan written in large font. It has 31 verses, with audio recitation for each verse.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah Al-Insan

Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned? Al-Insan [1]
Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing. Al-Insan [2]
Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful. Al-Insan [3]
Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze. Al-Insan [4]
Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur, Al-Insan [5]
A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance]. Al-Insan [6]
They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread. Al-Insan [7]
And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive, Al-Insan [8]
[Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah. We wish not from you reward or gratitude. Al-Insan [9]
Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful." Al-Insan [10]
So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness Al-Insan [11]
And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments]. Al-Insan [12]
[They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold. Al-Insan [13]
And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance. Al-Insan [14]
And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass], Al-Insan [15]
Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure. Al-Insan [16]
And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger Al-Insan [17]
[From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel. Al-Insan [18]
There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls. Al-Insan [19]
And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion. Al-Insan [20]
Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink. Al-Insan [21]
[And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated." Al-Insan [22]
Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively. Al-Insan [23]
So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever]. Al-Insan [24]
And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening Al-Insan [25]
And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night. Al-Insan [26]
Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day. Al-Insan [27]
We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration. Al-Insan [28]
Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way. Al-Insan [29]
And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise. Al-Insan [30]
He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment. Al-Insan [31]

ar.title: سورة البروج مكتوبة بخط كبير: 22 آية مع الترجمة الإنجليزية
ar.html:
نقدم سورة البروج مكتوبة بخط كبير، وعدد آياتها 22، مع تلاوة صوتية آية بآية.

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

سورة البروج

وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الْبُرُوجِ البروج [1]
وَالْيَوْمِ الْمَوْعُودِ البروج [2]
وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ البروج [3]
قُتِلَ أَصْحَابُ الْأُخْدُودِ البروج [4]
النَّارِ ذَاتِ الْوَقُودِ البروج [5]
إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ البروج [6]
وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ البروج [7]
وَمَا نَقَمُوا مِنْهُمْ إِلَّا أَن يُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَمِيدِ البروج [8]
الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ البروج [9]
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ الْحَرِيقِ البروج [10]
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْكَبِيرُ البروج [11]
إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ البروج [12]
إِنَّهُ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ البروج [13]
وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الْوَدُودُ البروج [14]
ذُو الْعَرْشِ الْمَجِيدُ البروج [15]
فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ البروج [16]
هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْجُنُودِ البروج [17]
فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ البروج [18]
بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي تَكْذِيبٍ البروج [19]
وَاللَّهُ مِن وَرَائِهِم مُّحِيطٌ البروج [20]
بَلْ هُوَ قُرْآنٌ مَّجِيدٌ البروج [21]
فِي لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍ البروج [22]

en.title: Surah Al-Burooj written in large font: 22 verses with English translation
en.html:
Surah Al-Burooj written in large font. It has 22 verses, with audio recitation for each verse.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah Al-Burooj

By the sky containing great stars Al-Burooj [1]
And [by] the promised Day Al-Burooj [2]
And [by] the witness and what is witnessed, Al-Burooj [3]
Cursed were the companions of the trench Al-Burooj [4]
[Containing] the fire full of fuel, Al-Burooj [5]
When they were sitting near it Al-Burooj [6]
And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses. Al-Burooj [7]
And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, Al-Burooj [8]
To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness. Al-Burooj [9]
Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire. Al-Burooj [10]
Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment. Al-Burooj [11]
Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe. Al-Burooj [12]
Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats. Al-Burooj [13]
And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate, Al-Burooj [14]
Honorable Owner of the Throne, Al-Burooj [15]
Effecter of what He intends. Al-Burooj [16]
Has there reached you the story of the soldiers - Al-Burooj [17]
[Those of] Pharaoh and Thamud? Al-Burooj [18]
But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial, Al-Burooj [19]
While Allah encompasses them from behind. Al-Burooj [20]
But this is an honored Qur'an Al-Burooj [21]
[Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate. Al-Burooj [22]

ar.title: سورة الطارق مكتوبة بخط كبير: 17 آية مع الترجمة الإنجليزية
ar.html:
نقدم سورة الطارق مكتوبة بخط كبير، وعدد آياتها 17، مع تلاوة صوتية آية بآية.

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

سورة الطارق

وَالسَّمَاءِ وَالطَّارِقِ الطارق [1]
وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الطَّارِقُ الطارق [2]
النَّجْمُ الثَّاقِبُ الطارق [3]
إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ الطارق [4]
فَلْيَنظُرِ الْإِنسَانُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ الطارق [5]
خُلِقَ مِن مَّاءٍ دَافِقٍ الطارق [6]
يَخْرُجُ مِن بَيْنِ الصُّلْبِ وَالتَّرَائِبِ الطارق [7]
إِنَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِ لَقَادِرٌ الطارق [8]
يَوْمَ تُبْلَى السَّرَائِرُ الطارق [9]
فَمَا لَهُ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ الطارق [10]
وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الرَّجْعِ الطارق [11]
وَالْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ الصَّدْعِ الطارق [12]
إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ الطارق [13]
وَمَا هُوَ بِالْهَزْلِ الطارق [14]
إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا الطارق [15]
وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا الطارق [16]
فَمَهِّلِ الْكَافِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًا الطارق [17]

en.title: Surah At-Tariq written in large font: 17 verses with English translation
en.html:
Surah At-Tariq written in large font. It has 17 verses, with audio recitation for each verse.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah At-Tariq

By the sky and the night comer - At-Tariq [1]
And what can make you know what is the night comer? At-Tariq [2]
It is the piercing star - At-Tariq [3]
There is no soul but that it has over it a protector. At-Tariq [4]
So let man observe from what he was created. At-Tariq [5]
He was created from a fluid, ejected, At-Tariq [6]
Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs. At-Tariq [7]
Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able. At-Tariq [8]
The Day when secrets will be put on trial, At-Tariq [9]
Then man will have no power or any helper. At-Tariq [10]
By the sky which returns [rain] At-Tariq [11]
And [by] the earth which cracks open, At-Tariq [12]
Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement, At-Tariq [13]
And it is not amusement. At-Tariq [14]
Indeed, they are planning a plan, At-Tariq [15]
But I am planning a plan. At-Tariq [16]
So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile. At-Tariq [17]

ar.html:
نقدم سورة الأعلى مكتوبة بخط كبير، وعدد آياتها 19، مع تلاوة صوتية آية بآية.

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

سورة الأعلى

سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْأَعْلَى الأعلى [1]
الَّذِي خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ الأعلى [2]
وَالَّذِي قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ الأعلى [3]
وَالَّذِي أَخْرَجَ الْمَرْعَىٰ الأعلى [4]
فَجَعَلَهُ غُثَاءً أَحْوَىٰ الأعلى [5]
سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰ الأعلى [6]
إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ الْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ الأعلى [7]
وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ الأعلى [8]
فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ الذِّكْرَىٰ الأعلى [9]
سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ الأعلى [10]
وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا الْأَشْقَى الأعلى [11]
الَّذِي يَصْلَى النَّارَ الْكُبْرَىٰ الأعلى [12]
ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ الأعلى [13]
قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ الأعلى [14]
وَذَكَرَ اسْمَ رَبِّهِ فَصَلَّىٰ الأعلى [15]
بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا الأعلى [16]
وَالْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ الأعلى [17]
إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِي الصُّحُفِ الْأُولَىٰ الأعلى [18]
صُحُفِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ الأعلى [19]

en.title: Surah Al-A'la written in large font: 19 verses with English translation
en.html:
Surah Al-A'la written in large font. It has 19 verses, with audio recitation for each verse.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah Al-A'la

Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High, Al-A'la [1]
Who created and proportioned Al-A'la [2]
And who destined and [then] guided Al-A'la [3]
And who brings out the pasture Al-A'la [4]
And [then] makes it black stubble. Al-A'la [5]
We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget, Al-A'la [6]
Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden. Al-A'la [7]
And We will ease you toward ease. Al-A'la [8]
So remind, if the reminder should benefit; Al-A'la [9]
He who fears [Allah] will be reminded. Al-A'la [10]
But the wretched one will avoid it - Al-A'la [11]
[He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire, Al-A'la [12]
Neither dying therein nor living. Al-A'la [13]
He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself Al-A'la [14]
And mentions the name of his Lord and prays. Al-A'la [15]
But you prefer the worldly life, Al-A'la [16]
While the Hereafter is better and more enduring. Al-A'la [17]
Indeed, this is in the former scriptures, Al-A'la [18]
The scriptures of Abraham and Moses. Al-A'la [19]

ar.title: سورة الغاشية مكتوبة بخط كبير: 26 آية مع الترجمة الإنجليزية
ar.html:
نقدم سورة الغاشية مكتوبة بخط كبير، وعدد آياتها 26، مع تلاوة صوتية آية بآية.

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

سورة الغاشية

هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْغَاشِيَةِ الغاشية [1]
وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَاشِعَةٌ الغاشية [2]
عَامِلَةٌ نَّاصِبَةٌ الغاشية [3]
تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةً الغاشية [4]
تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ آنِيَةٍ الغاشية [5]
لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍ الغاشية [6]
لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِي مِن جُوعٍ الغاشية [7]
وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاعِمَةٌ الغاشية [8]
لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌ الغاشية [9]
فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ الغاشية [10]
لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَاغِيَةً الغاشية [11]
فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ الغاشية [12]
فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ الغاشية [13]
وَأَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ الغاشية [14]
وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ الغاشية [15]
وَزَرَابِيُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ الغاشية [16]
أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى الْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ الغاشية [17]
وَإِلَى السَّمَاءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ الغاشية [18]
وَإِلَى الْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ الغاشية [19]
وَإِلَى الْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ الغاشية [20]
فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَا أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ الغاشية [21]
لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ الغاشية [22]
إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ الغاشية [23]
فَيُعَذِّبُهُ اللَّهُ الْعَذَابَ الْأَكْبَرَ الغاشية [24]
إِنَّ إِلَيْنَا إِيَابَهُمْ الغاشية [25]
ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم الغاشية [26]

en.title: Surah Al-Ghashiya written in large font: 26 verses with English translation
en.html:
Surah Al-Ghashiya written in large font. It has 26 verses, with audio recitation for each verse.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah Al-Ghashiya

Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]? Al-Ghashiya [1]
[Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled, Al-Ghashiya [2]
Working [hard] and exhausted. Al-Ghashiya [3]
They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire. Al-Ghashiya [4]
They will be given drink from a boiling spring. Al-Ghashiya [5]
For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant Al-Ghashiya [6]
Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger. Al-Ghashiya [7]
[Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure. Al-Ghashiya [8]
With their effort [they are] satisfied Al-Ghashiya [9]
In an elevated garden, Al-Ghashiya [10]
Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech. Al-Ghashiya [11]
Within it is a flowing spring. Al-Ghashiya [12]
Within it are couches raised high Al-Ghashiya [13]
And cups put in place Al-Ghashiya [14]
And cushions lined up Al-Ghashiya [15]
And carpets spread around. Al-Ghashiya [16]
Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created? Al-Ghashiya [17]
And at the sky - how it is raised? Al-Ghashiya [18]
And at the mountains - how they are erected? Al-Ghashiya [19]
And at the earth - how it is spread out? Al-Ghashiya [20]
So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder. Al-Ghashiya [21]
You are not over them a controller. Al-Ghashiya [22]
However, he who turns away and disbelieves - Al-Ghashiya [23]
Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment. Al-Ghashiya [24]
Indeed, to Us is their return. Al-Ghashiya [25]
Then indeed, upon Us is their account. Al-Ghashiya [26]

ar.title: سورة الفجر مكتوبة بخط كبير: 30 آية مع الترجمة الإنجليزية
ar.html:
نقدم سورة الفجر مكتوبة بخط كبير، وعدد آياتها 30، مع تلاوة صوتية آية بآية.

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

سورة الفجر

وَالْفَجْرِ الفجر [1]
وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍ الفجر [2]
وَالشَّفْعِ وَالْوَتْرِ الفجر [3]
وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ الفجر [4]
هَلْ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِي حِجْرٍ الفجر [5]
أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ الفجر [6]
إِرَمَ ذَاتِ الْعِمَادِ الفجر [7]
الَّتِي لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِي الْبِلَادِ الفجر [8]
وَثَمُودَ الَّذِينَ جَابُوا الصَّخْرَ بِالْوَادِ الفجر [9]
وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِي الْأَوْتَادِ الفجر [10]
الَّذِينَ طَغَوْا فِي الْبِلَادِ الفجر [11]
فَأَكْثَرُوا فِيهَا الْفَسَادَ الفجر [12]
فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ الفجر [13]
إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِالْمِرْصَادِ الفجر [14]
فَأَمَّا الْإِنسَانُ إِذَا مَا ابْتَلَاهُ رَبُّهُ فَأَكْرَمَهُ وَنَعَّمَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّي أَكْرَمَنِ الفجر [15]
وَأَمَّا إِذَا مَا ابْتَلَاهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّي أَهَانَنِ الفجر [16]
كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ الْيَتِيمَ الفجر [17]
وَلَا تَحَاضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ الفجر [18]
وَتَأْكُلُونَ التُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَّمًّا الفجر [19]
وَتُحِبُّونَ الْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا الفجر [20]
كَلَّا إِذَا دُكَّتِ الْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا الفجر [21]
وَجَاءَ رَبُّكَ وَالْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا الفجر [22]
وَجِيءَ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ الْإِنسَانُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ الذِّكْرَىٰ الفجر [23]
يَقُولُ يَا لَيْتَنِي قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِي الفجر [24]
فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُ أَحَدٌ الفجر [25]
وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُ أَحَدٌ الفجر [26]
يَا أَيَّتُهَا النَّفْسُ الْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ الفجر [27]
ارْجِعِي إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً الفجر [28]
فَادْخُلِي فِي عِبَادِي الفجر [29]
وَادْخُلِي جَنَّتِي الفجر [30]

en.title: Surah Al-Fajr written in large font: 30 verses with English translation
en.html:
Surah Al-Fajr written in large font. It has 30 verses, with audio recitation for each verse.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah Al-Fajr

By the dawn Al-Fajr [1]
And [by] ten nights Al-Fajr [2]
And [by] the even [number] and the odd Al-Fajr [3]
And [by] the night when it passes, Al-Fajr [4]
Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception? Al-Fajr [5]
Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad - Al-Fajr [6]
[With] Iram - who had lofty pillars, Al-Fajr [7]
The likes of whom had never been created in the land? Al-Fajr [8]
And [with] Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley? Al-Fajr [9]
And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes? - Al-Fajr [10]
[All of] whom oppressed within the lands Al-Fajr [11]
And increased therein the corruption. Al-Fajr [12]
So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment. Al-Fajr [13]
Indeed, your Lord is in observation. Al-Fajr [14]
And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me." Al-Fajr [15]
But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me." Al-Fajr [16]
No! But you do not honor the orphan Al-Fajr [17]
And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor. Al-Fajr [18]
And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether, Al-Fajr [19]
And you love wealth with immense love. Al-Fajr [20]
No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed - Al-Fajr [21]
And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank, Al-Fajr [22]
And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance? Al-Fajr [23]
He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life." Al-Fajr [24]
So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment, Al-Fajr [25]
And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers]. Al-Fajr [26]
[To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul, Al-Fajr [27]
Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him], Al-Fajr [28]
And enter among My [righteous] servants Al-Fajr [29]
And enter My Paradise." Al-Fajr [30]

ar.title: سورة البلد مكتوبة بخط كبير: 20 آية مع الترجمة الإنجليزية
ar.html:
نقدم سورة البلد مكتوبة بخط كبير، وعدد آياتها 20، مع تلاوة صوتية آية بآية.

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

سورة البلد

لَا أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا الْبَلَدِ البلد [1]
وَأَنتَ حِلٌّ بِهَٰذَا الْبَلَدِ البلد [2]
وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ البلد [3]
لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ فِي كَبَدٍ البلد [4]
أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ البلد [5]
يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًا لُّبَدًا البلد [6]
أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُ أَحَدٌ البلد [7]
أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُ عَيْنَيْنِ البلد [8]
وَلِسَانًا وَشَفَتَيْنِ البلد [9]
وَهَدَيْنَاهُ النَّجْدَيْنِ البلد [10]
فَلَا اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ البلد [11]
وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْعَقَبَةُ البلد [12]
فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ البلد [13]
أَوْ إِطْعَامٌ فِي يَوْمٍ ذِي مَسْغَبَةٍ البلد [14]
يَتِيمًا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ البلد [15]
أَوْ مِسْكِينًا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍ البلد [16]
ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْمَرْحَمَةِ البلد [17]
أُولَٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ البلد [18]
وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَابُ الْمَشْأَمَةِ البلد [19]
عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُّؤْصَدَةٌ البلد [20]

en.title: Surah Al-Balad written in large font: 20 verses with English translation
en.html:
Surah Al-Balad written in large font. It has 20 verses, with audio recitation for each verse.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah Al-Balad

I swear by this city, Makkah - Al-Balad [1]
And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city - Al-Balad [2]
And [by] the father and that which was born [of him], Al-Balad [3]
We have certainly created man into hardship. Al-Balad [4]
Does he think that never will anyone overcome him? Al-Balad [5]
He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance." Al-Balad [6]
Does he think that no one has seen him? Al-Balad [7]
Have We not made for him two eyes? Al-Balad [8]
And a tongue and two lips? Al-Balad [9]
And have shown him the two ways? Al-Balad [10]
But he has not broken through the difficult pass. Al-Balad [11]
And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass? Al-Balad [12]
It is the freeing of a slave Al-Balad [13]
Or feeding on a day of severe hunger Al-Balad [14]
An orphan of near relationship Al-Balad [15]
Or a needy person in misery Al-Balad [16]
And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion. Al-Balad [17]
Those are the companions of the right. Al-Balad [18]
But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left. Al-Balad [19]
Over them will be fire closed in. Al-Balad [20]

سورة الشمس

وَالشَّمْسِ وَضُحَاهَا الشمس [1]
وَالْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَاهَا الشمس [2]
وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّاهَا الشمس [3]
وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَاهَا الشمس [4]
وَالسَّمَاءِ وَمَا بَنَاهَا الشمس [5]
وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَاهَا الشمس [6]
وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّاهَا الشمس [7]
فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَاهَا الشمس [8]
قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّاهَا الشمس [9]
وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّاهَا الشمس [10]
كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَاهَا الشمس [11]
إِذِ انبَعَثَ أَشْقَاهَا الشمس [12]
فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ نَاقَةَ اللَّهِ وَسُقْيَاهَا الشمس [13]
فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنبِهِمْ فَسَوَّاهَا الشمس [14]
وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَاهَا الشمس [15]

en.title: Surah Ash-Shams written in large font: 15 verses with English translation
en.html:
Surah Ash-Shams written in large font. It has 15 verses, with audio recitation for each verse.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah Ash-Shams

By the sun and its brightness Ash-Shams [1]
And [by] the moon when it follows it Ash-Shams [2]
And [by] the day when it displays it Ash-Shams [3]
And [by] the night when it covers it Ash-Shams [4]
And [by] the sky and He who constructed it Ash-Shams [5]
And [by] the earth and He who spread it Ash-Shams [6]
And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it Ash-Shams [7]
And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness, Ash-Shams [8]
He has succeeded who purifies it, Ash-Shams [9]
And he has failed who instills it [with corruption]. Ash-Shams [10]
Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression, Ash-Shams [11]
When the most wretched of them was sent forth. Ash-Shams [12]
And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink." Ash-Shams [13]
But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them]. Ash-Shams [14]
And He does not fear the consequence thereof. Ash-Shams [15]

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

سورة الليل

وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ الليل [1]
وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ الليل [2]
وَمَا خَلَقَ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنثَىٰ الليل [3]
إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ الليل [4]
فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَاتَّقَىٰ الليل [5]
وَصَدَّقَ بِالْحُسْنَىٰ الليل [6]
فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ الليل [7]
وَأَمَّا مَن بَخِلَ وَاسْتَغْنَىٰ الليل [8]
وَكَذَّبَ بِالْحُسْنَىٰ الليل [9]
فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ الليل [10]
وَمَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُ مَالُهُ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰ الليل [11]
إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ الليل [12]
وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْآخِرَةَ وَالْأُولَىٰ الليل [13]
فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ الليل [14]
لَا يَصْلَاهَا إِلَّا الْأَشْقَى الليل [15]
الَّذِي كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ الليل [16]
وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا الْأَتْقَى الليل [17]
الَّذِي يُؤْتِي مَالَهُ يَتَزَكَّىٰ الليل [18]
وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰ الليل [19]
إِلَّا ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ الْأَعْلَىٰ الليل [20]
وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ الليل [21]

en.title: Surah Al-Layl written in large font: 21 verses with English translation
en.html:
Surah Al-Layl written in large font. It has 21 verses, with audio recitation for each verse.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah Al-Layl

By the night when it covers Al-Layl [1]
And [by] the day when it appears Al-Layl [2]
And [by] He who created the male and female, Al-Layl [3]
Indeed, your efforts are diverse. Al-Layl [4]
As for he who gives and fears Allah Al-Layl [5]
And believes in the best [reward], Al-Layl [6]
We will ease him toward ease. Al-Layl [7]
But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need Al-Layl [8]
And denies the best [reward], Al-Layl [9]
We will ease him toward difficulty. Al-Layl [10]
And what will his wealth avail him when he falls? Al-Layl [11]
Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance. Al-Layl [12]
And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life]. Al-Layl [13]
So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing. Al-Layl [14]
None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one. Al-Layl [15]
Who had denied and turned away. Al-Layl [16]
But the righteous one will avoid it - Al-Layl [17]
[He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself Al-Layl [18]
And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded Al-Layl [19]
But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High. Al-Layl [20]
And he is going to be satisfied. Al-Layl [21]

أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَآوَىٰ الضحى [6]
وَوَجَدَكَ ضَالًّا فَهَدَىٰ الضحى [7]
وَوَجَدَكَ عَائِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ الضحى [8]
فَأَمَّا الْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ الضحى [9]
وَأَمَّا السَّائِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ الضحى [10]
وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ الضحى [11]

en.html:
Surah Ad-Dhuha written in large font. It has 11 verses, with audio recitation for each verse.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah Ad-Dhuha

By the morning brightness Ad-Dhuha [1]
And [by] the night when it covers with darkness, Ad-Dhuha [2]
Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you]. Ad-Dhuha [3]
And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life]. Ad-Dhuha [4]
And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied. Ad-Dhuha [5]
Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge? Ad-Dhuha [6]
And He found you lost and guided [you], Ad-Dhuha [7]
And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient. Ad-Dhuha [8]
So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him]. Ad-Dhuha [9]
And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him]. Ad-Dhuha [10]
But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it]. Ad-Dhuha [11]

Surah As-Sharh

Surah At-Tin

By the fig and the olive At-Tin [1]

خَلَقَ الْإِنسَانَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ العلق [2]

أَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي يَنْهَىٰ العلق [9]
عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰ العلق [10]
أَرَأَيْتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى الْهُدَىٰ العلق [11]
أَوْ أَمَرَ بِالتَّقْوَىٰ العلق [12]
أَرَأَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ العلق [13]
أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَرَىٰ العلق [14]
كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًا بِالنَّاصِيَةِ العلق [15]
نَاصِيَةٍ كَاذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍ العلق [16]
فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُ العلق [17]
سَنَدْعُ الزَّبَانِيَةَ العلق [18]
كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَاسْجُدْ وَاقْتَرِب ۩ العلق [19]

en.title: Surah Al-'alaq written in large font: 19 verses with English translation
en.html:
Surah Al-'alaq written in large font. It has 19 verses, with audio recitation for each verse.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah Al-'alaq

Recite in the name of your Lord who created - Al-'alaq [1]
Created man from a clinging substance. Al-'alaq [2]
Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous - Al-'alaq [3]
Who taught by the pen - Al-'alaq [4]
Taught man that which he knew not. Al-'alaq [5]
No! [But] indeed, man transgresses Al-'alaq [6]
Because he sees himself self-sufficient. Al-'alaq [7]
Indeed, to your Lord is the return. Al-'alaq [8]
Have you seen the one who forbids Al-'alaq [9]
A servant when he prays? Al-'alaq [10]
Have you seen if he is upon guidance Al-'alaq [11]
Or enjoins righteousness? Al-'alaq [12]
Have you seen if he denies and turns away - Al-'alaq [13]
Does he not know that Allah sees? Al-'alaq [14]
No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock - Al-'alaq [15]
A lying, sinning forelock. Al-'alaq [16]
Then let him call his associates; Al-'alaq [17]
We will call the angels of Hell. Al-'alaq [18]
No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah]. Al-'alaq [19]

وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ القدر [2]

تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ القدر [4]
سَلَامٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ الْفَجْرِ القدر [5]

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah Al-Qadr

Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree. Al-Qadr [1]
And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree? Al-Qadr [2]
The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months. Al-Qadr [3]
The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter. Al-Qadr [4]
Peace it is until the emergence of dawn. Al-Qadr [5]

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

سورة البينة

لَمْ يَكُنِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ البينة [1]
رَسُولٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ يَتْلُو صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً البينة [2]
فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ البينة [3]
وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا مِن بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَتْهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ البينة [4]
وَمَا أُمِرُوا إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ حُنَفَاءَ وَيُقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَيُؤْتُوا الزَّكَاةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ الْقَيِّمَةِ البينة [5]
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ الْبَرِيَّةِ البينة [6]
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ أُولَٰئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ الْبَرِيَّةِ البينة [7]
جَزَاؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا ۖ رَّضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِيَ رَبَّهُ البينة [8]

en.title: Surah Al-Bayyinah written in large font: 8 verses with English translation
en.html:
Surah Al-Bayyinah written in large font. It has 8 verses, with audio recitation for each verse.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah Al-Bayyinah

Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence - Al-Bayyinah [1]
A Messenger from Allah, reciting purified scriptures Al-Bayyinah [2]
Within which are correct writings. Al-Bayyinah [3]
Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence. Al-Bayyinah [4]
And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakah. And that is the correct religion. Al-Bayyinah [5]
Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures. Al-Bayyinah [6]
Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures. Al-Bayyinah [7]
Their reward with Allah will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord. Al-Bayyinah [8]

وَأَخْرَجَتِ الْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا الزلزلة [2]
وَقَالَ الْإِنسَانُ مَا لَهَا الزلزلة [3]
يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا الزلزلة [4]
بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا الزلزلة [5]

فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ الزلزلة [7]

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah Az-Zalzalah

When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake Az-Zalzalah [1]
And the earth discharges its burdens Az-Zalzalah [2]
And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" - Az-Zalzalah [3]
That Day, it will report its news Az-Zalzalah [4]
Because your Lord has commanded it. Az-Zalzalah [5]
That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds. Az-Zalzalah [6]
So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it, Az-Zalzalah [7]
And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it. Az-Zalzalah [8]

وَالْعَادِيَاتِ ضَبْحًا العاديات [1]
فَالْمُورِيَاتِ قَدْحًا العاديات [2]

فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِ جَمْعًا العاديات [5]
إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ لِرَبِّهِ لَكَنُودٌ العاديات [6]
وَإِنَّهُ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ العاديات [7]
وَإِنَّهُ لِحُبِّ الْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ العاديات [8]
أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِي الْقُبُورِ العاديات [9]
وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِي الصُّدُورِ العاديات [10]

en.html:
Surah Al-'adiyat written in large font. It has 11 verses, with audio recitation for each verse.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah Al-'adiyat

By the racers, panting, Al-'adiyat [1]
And the producers of sparks [when] striking Al-'adiyat [2]
And the chargers at dawn, Al-'adiyat [3]
Stirring up thereby [clouds of] dust, Al-'adiyat [4]
Arriving thereby in the center collectively, Al-'adiyat [5]
Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful. Al-'adiyat [6]
And indeed, he is to that a witness. Al-'adiyat [7]
And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense. Al-'adiyat [8]
But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered Al-'adiyat [9]
And that within the breasts is obtained, Al-'adiyat [10]
Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted. Al-'adiyat [11]

سورة القارعة

الْقَارِعَةُ القارعة [1]
مَا الْقَارِعَةُ القارعة [2]
وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْقَارِعَةُ القارعة [3]
يَوْمَ يَكُونُ النَّاسُ كَالْفَرَاشِ الْمَبْثُوثِ القارعة [4]
وَتَكُونُ الْجِبَالُ كَالْعِهْنِ الْمَنفُوشِ القارعة [5]
فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِينُهُ القارعة [6]
فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ القارعة [7]
وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِينُهُ القارعة [8]
فَأُمُّهُ هَاوِيَةٌ القارعة [9]
وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا هِيَهْ القارعة [10]
نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌ القارعة [11]

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah Al-Qari'ah

The Striking Calamity - Al-Qari'ah [1]
What is the Striking Calamity? Al-Qari'ah [2]
And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity? Al-Qari'ah [3]
It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed, Al-Qari'ah [4]
And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up. Al-Qari'ah [5]
Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds], Al-Qari'ah [6]
He will be in a pleasant life. Al-Qari'ah [7]
But as for one whose scales are light, Al-Qari'ah [8]
His refuge will be an abyss. Al-Qari'ah [9]
And what can make you know what that is? Al-Qari'ah [10]
It is a Fire, intensely hot. Al-Qari'ah [11]

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah At-Takathur

Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you At-Takathur [1]
Until you visit the graveyards. At-Takathur [2]
No! You are going to know. At-Takathur [3]
Then no! You are going to know. At-Takathur [4]

You will surely see the Hellfire. At-Takathur [6]
Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty. At-Takathur [7]
Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure. At-Takathur [8]

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah Al-Humazah

Woe to every scorner and mocker Al-Humazah [1]
Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it. Al-Humazah [2]
He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal. Al-Humazah [3]
No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher. Al-Humazah [4]
And what can make you know what is the Crusher? Al-Humazah [5]
It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled, Al-Humazah [6]
Which mounts directed at the hearts. Al-Humazah [7]
Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them Al-Humazah [8]
In extended columns. Al-Humazah [9]

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

سورة الفلق

قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ الفلق [1]
مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ الفلق [2]
وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ الفلق [3]
وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ الفلق [4]
وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ الفلق [5]

en.title: Surah Al-Falaq written in large font: 5 verses with English translation
en.html:
Surah Al-Falaq written in large font. It has 5 verses, with audio recitation for each verse.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah Al-Falaq

Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak Al-Falaq [1]
From the evil of that which He created Al-Falaq [2]
And from the evil of darkness when it settles Al-Falaq [3]
And from the evil of the blowers in knots Al-Falaq [4]
And from the evil of an envier when he envies." Al-Falaq [5]

en.title: Surah An-Nas written in large font: 6 verses with English translation
en.html:
Surah An-Nas written in large font. It has 6 verses, with audio recitation for each verse.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Surah An-Nas

Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, An-Nas [1]
The Sovereign of mankind. An-Nas [2]
The God of mankind, An-Nas [3]
From the evil of the retreating whisperer - An-Nas [4]
Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind - An-Nas [5]
From among the jinn and mankind." An-Nas [6]
